subject: Decision to Create New Charter Document
overview: The committee voted to draft an entirely new charter document to replace Medford’s existing patchwork of governing statutes. Members also discussed public outreach strategies, including a translated brochure and a planned information session in June.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Charter Structure and Collins Center Presentation
items.summary: Approved drafting a new, comprehensive charter document instead of amending the existing collection of special acts and statutes. Representatives from the Collins Center advised that a unified document would improve transparency and avoid lengthy state legislative delays associated with individual amendments.

items.title: Public Outreach and Meeting Frequency
items.summary: Set a goal to hold an initial public information session in June and agreed to increase meeting frequency to twice monthly to facilitate the drafting process.

items.title: Informational Brochure and Budget Logistics
items.summary: Reviewed a draft informational brochure, approved its translation into multiple languages, and discussed requesting a formal budget allocation for committee costs.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: A resident expressed support for the committee's work and commented on a conduct issue from a prior meeting.
